text:
ryan (eng): Heads up — eu-auth incident just popped, large error spike across canaries. I think we should pull today's slot and move it to the evening window tomorrow.

deploy-bot: Deploy scheduled: 2026-04-02T00:00Z (change-window A). Tag: v1.9.4-candidate. Status: queued.

maria (release mgr): +1 to hold. We haven't finished the final e2e from yesterday and the incident could be related to token handling in the new runtime.

ops-oncall: Confirmed auth errors hitting 503s on token-verify. We're debugging, ETA 30m. Can we keep the slot unallocated until we have root cause?

ryan (eng): I'd prefer not to roll forward into a slot if auth is flaky. Proposal: immediate hold on change-window A, move v1.9.4-candidate to change-window B (2026-04-02T20:00Z). If we resolve before B we can attempt a canary early.

deploy-bot: Action executed: change-window A flagged as HOLD by ryan (eng). Slot reassign pending manual confirm.

maria (release mgr): For bookkeeping, I'll pin the current production to v1.9.3 and update release notes to note the hold and root-cause linking. Samira, can you add a small blurb to the public release notes?

samira (prod): On it. I'll add: "Release delayed due to an authentication regression under investigation; will provide update by 16:30 UTC."

nolan (platform): Re: pinning — we should also add a short rollback path in the runbook in case the candidate partially rolls out. Suggest adding these commands to the runbook:

```
# rollback to pinned prod tag
deploy-bot rollback --service auth --to-tag v1.9.3 --graceful
# mark slot as unavailable
deploy-bot mark-slot --window 2026-04-02T00:00Z --status unavailable
```

ops-oncall: Agree. Also adding a temporary routing rule to avoid eu-auth canaries until we validate: `route-control set canary eu-auth disable`

ryan (eng): Quick decision: hold the slot, pin prod, add rollback steps, and schedule candidate to 2026-04-02T20:00Z. If we find fix sooner we can re-evaluate for 12:00Z secondary slot. Maria — please confirm schedule change.

maria (release mgr): Confirmed. I'm updating the release calendar, noting the hold reason and the new tentative window. I'll also create a short changelog entry and link the incident ticket #INC-4729.

deploy-bot: Calendar update requested by maria (release mgr): moved v1.9.4-candidate -> 2026-04-02T20:00Z (tentative). Old slot 2026-04-02T00:00Z set to HOLD.

samira (prod): Adding the public blurb and internal changelog now. Also flagging a postmortem to include release gating improvements (canary isolation).

ryan (eng): Thanks. If ops gets a fix before 12:00Z call me and we can try an early canary. Otherwise we'll aim for the evening window.

ops-oncall: Update: root cause narrowed to a KV cache invalidation during token refresh under high concurrency. Working on a short patch, testing in staging. ETA 1h for internal patch, then staging verification.

maria (release mgr): OK — keeping evening slot reserved. I will notify stakeholders and update the release-notes draft with the hold reason and new window.

deploy-bot: Thread action summary: HOLD placed on 2026-04-02T00:00Z; v1.9.4-candidate rescheduled to 2026-04-02T20:00Z (tentative); prod pinned to v1.9.3; rollback runbook commands suggested.

ryan (eng): Good coordination — please react with :white_check_mark: once your action item is done (pin, changelog, patch test).
